data.name: UseSourceOptionDescription
data.value: Accept or decline the proposed Git configuration source for this project.

data.name: RefreshOptionDescription
data.value: Apply allowed settings from the nearest local and global saved Git configuration sources, replacing local edits to supplied settings, without updating packages or the CLI.

data.name: InvalidRepository
data.value: The configuration source must be an absolute local repository path or an HTTPS or SSH Git repository address without passwords, tokens, queries, or fragments.

data.name: InvalidPath
data.value: The configuration file must be a nonempty repository-relative path using '/' separators, without '.', '..', or empty path segments.

data.name: InvalidRef
data.value: The configuration source ref must be a branch name or full commit SHA, not an empty value, tag, revision expression, or command option.

data.name: MissingFile
data.value: The configuration file is missing or is not a regular file at the selected Git branch or commit.

data.name: InvalidConfiguration
data.value: The source configuration must be a valid Aspire JSON object no larger than 4 MiB.

data.name: NestedSource
data.value: A source configuration file cannot declare another configSource.

data.name: GitTimeout
data.value: The configuration source Git operation timed out. Check repository access and Git credentials, then retry.

data.name: GitNotFound
data.value: Git could not be started. Ensure Git is installed and available on PATH to use this configuration source.

data.name: AuthenticationFailed
data.value: Git could not authenticate to the configuration source. Configure your Git credential helper or SSH authentication and retry.

data.name: RepositoryUnavailable
data.value: Git could not read the configuration source repository. Check repository access, network connectivity, and Git authentication, then retry.

data.name: NoCandidate
data.value: No configuration source is available. Set {0} to a Git repository address.

data.name: Candidate
data.comment: {0} is the Git repository address, {1} is the repository-relative configuration file path, {2} is the branch name, commit SHA, or default-branch label, and {3} is the source origin (an environment variable name or Microsoft employee default).

data.name: DefaultBranch
data.value: default branch

data.name: EmployeeOrigin
data.value: Microsoft employee default

data.name: UseSourcePrompt
data.value: Use configuration from this source?

data.name: Accept
data.value: Yes

data.name: Decline
data.value: No, use standard Aspire configuration

data.name: ConsentRequired
data.value: A configuration source is available. Specify --use-config-source true to accept it or --use-config-source false to use standard Aspire configuration in non-interactive mode.

data.name: NoBinding
data.value: No configuration source to update.

data.name: InvalidBinding
data.value: The configSource binding must contain a Git repository address and a repository-relative configuration file path.

data.name: InvalidCache
data.value: The configuration source cache is invalid. Restore or remove its cache entry and retry.

data.name: UseNotice
data.value: Configuration source {0} ({1}) at commit {2}: {3}. Settings file: {4}
data.comment: {0} is the Git repository address, {1} is the repository-relative configuration file path, {2} is the resolved Git commit SHA, {3} is the localized configuration update result, and {4} is the destination settings file path.

data.name: Refreshed
data.value: configuration updated

data.name: RefreshedUnchanged
data.value: configuration already up to date

data.name: UpdateAvailable
data.value: A new version of the configuration source is available. Run `aspire update --config-source` to apply it.

data.name: AppliedVersionMissing
data.value: A saved configuration source has no recorded applied version. Run `aspire update --config-source` to save its allowed settings and establish the applied version.

data.name: CheckFailed
data.value: The configuration source update check failed: {0} Continuing with the saved configuration.
data.comment: {0} is the configuration source check failure message.

data.name: CheckFailedWithoutDetails
data.value: The configuration source update check failed. Continuing with the saved configuration.

data.name: ConfigLockFailed
data.value: The settings file could not be locked. No source settings were applied. Retry when other configuration writers have finished.

data.name: BindingChanged
data.value: The saved configuration source changed while fetching. No source settings were applied. Retry using the saved source binding.

data.name: IncompatibleOptions
data.value: --config-source cannot be combined with --self, --migrate, --channel, --quality, or --nuget-config-dir.
data.comment: Do not translate the command-line option names.
